title: 电池与锂电池安全
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/103_电池与锂电池安全.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/103_电池与锂电池安全/src.py

points.K1: 电池没有开关，两极别短接
points.K2: 锂电池充电：合格充电器，有人看管
points.S2: 电动自行车和电池不进楼
points.K3: 鼓包漏液就停用，废电池按规定回收

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一块鼓起来的锂电池，表情严肃
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a swollen lithium battery pack with a serious face.
shots.narration: 这一课讲电池与锂电池安全。

shots.scene: 实验室桌上，几块电池和钥匙、螺丝刀混在抽屉里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: loose batteries mixed with keys and a screwdriver in a lab drawer. No text.
shots.narration: 阿杰的抽屉里，电池和钥匙混在一起。

shots.scene: 阿杰把充电宝插上充电，准备去吃饭
shots.prompt_en: The young male student plugs in a power bank to charge and turns to leave for lunch.
shots.narration: 他给充电宝充上电，转身要走。

shots.scene: 小研叫住他，指着发热的充电宝
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student calls him back and points at the warm power bank.
shots.narration: 小研说：充电要有人看着。

shots.scene: 手机、充电宝、电动工具、电动车四种电池图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four battery icons, a phone, a power bank, a cordless drill and an electric bike. No text.
shots.narration: 锂电池到处都是，能量很大。

shots.scene: 短路、过热、鼓包、漏液四个危险图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four hazard icons, a short circuit spark, a heat wave, a swollen cell and a leak. No text.
shots.narration: 短路、过热、鼓包、漏液，都危险。

shots.scene: 过充、挤压、穿刺、进水四个原因图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four cause icons, overcharging, crushing, puncturing and water getting in. No text.
shots.narration: 过充、挤压、刺破、进水会损伤它。

shots.scene: 一个电芯发热，热量传给旁边的电芯，连锁升温
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one cell heating up and passing heat to the next cells in a chain reaction. No text.
shots.narration: 内部失控升温，叫热失控。

shots.scene: 电池喷出火焰和浓烟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a battery venting flames and thick smoke. No text.
shots.narration: 会喷火、冒有毒烟，还会复燃。

shots.scene: 仪器内的大电池组，旁边闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large battery pack inside equipment with a lightning icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 大电池组电流大，也有电击危险。

shots.section_title: 电池没有开关，两极别短接
shots.scene: 电池旁边没有开关，闪电图标一直亮着
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a battery with no switch, a lightning icon always lit beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 电池没有开关，随时都带电。
overlay: 电池没有开关，两极别短接

shots.section_title: 电池没有开关，两极别短接
shots.scene: 扳手搭在电池两极上冒火花，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wrench lying across both battery terminals and sparking, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 金属搭住两极，会短路发烫。

shots.section_title: 电池没有开关，两极别短接
shots.scene: 电池和钥匙硬币放在口袋里，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: batteries in a pocket with keys and coins, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电池别和钥匙硬币混放。

shots.section_title: 电池没有开关，两极别短接
shots.scene: 【实拍】给散装电池端子贴绝缘胶带、套上护帽，正负分开放进盒子
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands taping the terminals of loose batteries and fitting caps, then placing them apart in a box.
shots.narration: 不用时贴胶带、套护帽，分开放。

shots.section_title: 锂电池充电：合格充电器，有人看管
shots.scene: 【实拍】充电器外壳上的认证标志特写（遮挡品牌型号）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a certification mark on the case of a battery charger.
shots.narration: 用原装或合格的充电器。
overlay: 锂电池充电：合格充电器，有人看管

shots.section_title: 锂电池充电：合格充电器，有人看管
shots.scene: 来路不明的充电器、改装的电池，两个打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unbranded charger and a modified battery pack, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 劣质充电器、改装电池不能用。

shots.section_title: 锂电池充电：合格充电器，有人看管
shots.scene: 电池放在不燃台面上充电，人在旁边
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a battery charging on a non flammable bench while a person stays nearby. No text.
shots.narration: 放在不燃的台面上，人不离开。

shots.section_title: 锂电池充电：合格充电器，有人看管
shots.scene: 充电时人离开、夜里睡觉，两个打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a charging battery left alone in an empty room and at night beside a sleeping person, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 人走不充电，充电不过夜。

shots.section_title: 锂电池充电：合格充电器，有人看管
shots.scene: 电量满格，手拔下插头
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a full battery icon and a hand unplugging the charger. No text.
shots.narration: 充满就拔，别长时间挂着。

shots.section_title: 锂电池充电：合格充电器，有人看管
shots.scene: 充电宝放在被子上和纸堆里，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power bank charging on a quilt and on a pile of paper, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不在床上、纸堆旁充电。

shots.section_title: 锂电池充电：合格充电器，有人看管
shots.scene: 电池发烫冒烟，手按下插座开关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a battery getting hot and smoking, a hand switching off the socket. No text.
shots.narration: 发烫、异味、冒烟，立即断电。

shots.section_title: 电动自行车和电池不进楼
shots.scene: 电动自行车推进楼道和电梯，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an electric bike being pushed into a corridor and an elevator, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电动自行车和电池不进楼。
overlay: 电动自行车和电池不进楼

shots.section_title: 电动自行车和电池不进楼
shots.scene: 电池拎进宿舍、实验室充电，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an e-bike battery carried into a dorm room and a lab to charge, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不在宿舍、实验室、楼道里充电。

shots.section_title: 电动自行车和电池不进楼
shots.scene: 室外集中充电棚里，电动车有序充电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: electric bikes charging in an outdoor charging shelter on campus. No text.
shots.narration: 到学校指定地点停放充电。

shots.section_title: 电动自行车和电池不进楼
shots.scene: 飞线充电从窗户垂下，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an extension cord hanging out of a window to charge a bike below, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不私拉电线飞线充电。

shots.section_title: 鼓包漏液就停用，废电池按规定回收
shots.scene: 鼓包、漏液、发烫的三块电池
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three batteries, one swollen, one leaking and one hot. No text.
shots.narration: 鼓包、漏液、发烫，都是危险信号。
overlay: 鼓包漏液就停用，废电池按规定回收

shots.section_title: 鼓包漏液就停用，废电池按规定回收
shots.scene: 鼓包电池继续塞回设备，打叉；按压鼓包，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a swollen battery pushed back into a device and a thumb pressing the bulge, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 立即停用，不按压、不再充电。

shots.section_title: 鼓包漏液就停用，废电池按规定回收
shots.scene: 鼓包电池放进盛沙的金属盒，远离可燃物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a swollen battery placed in a metal box with sand, away from flammable items. No text.
shots.narration: 隔离存放，远离可燃物。

shots.section_title: 鼓包漏液就停用，废电池按规定回收
shots.scene: 漏液电池旁，戴手套的手用纸巾包起
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gloved hand wrapping a leaking battery in paper towels. No text.
shots.narration: 漏液别用手碰，戴手套处理。

shots.section_title: 鼓包漏液就停用，废电池按规定回收
shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports the damaged battery to the older man.
shots.narration: 报告老师，不自己拆。

shots.section_title: 鼓包漏液就停用，废电池按规定回收
shots.scene: 【实拍】把贴好端子胶带的废电池投入专用回收箱
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: taped used batteries being dropped into a dedicated battery recycling box.
shots.narration: 废电池投进专用回收箱。

shots.section_title: 鼓包漏液就停用，废电池按规定回收
shots.scene: 废电池扔进普通垃圾桶，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: used batteries thrown into an ordinary trash bin, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不混扔，按学校规定回收处置。

shots.scene: 电池放在阴凉干燥的柜子里
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: batteries stored in a cool, dry cabinet. No text.
shots.narration: 电池存放在阴凉干燥处。

shots.scene: 电池在暖气片旁和阳光下暴晒，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: batteries next to a radiator and in direct sunlight, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 远离热源，不暴晒。

shots.scene: 电池和溶剂瓶、纸箱堆在一起，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: batteries piled together with solvent bottles and cardboard, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不和易燃物、化学品混放。

shots.scene: 长期不用的电池保持半电存放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a battery gauge showing about half charge for long term storage. No text.
shots.narration: 长期不用，按说明书保持适当电量。

shots.scene: 电池测试实验在防火柜内进行，旁边灭火器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a battery test set up inside a fire resistant cabinet, an extinguisher nearby. No text.
shots.narration: 电池实验按本校规定防火防爆。

shots.scene: 电池冒烟，人先拉开距离
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a battery starting to smoke and a person stepping back. No text.
shots.narration: 电池冒烟，先断电，人后退。

shots.scene: 徒手去拿冒烟的电池，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bare hand reaching for a smoking battery, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不要徒手去拿，烟有毒。

shots.scene: 小火时用灭火器和大量水降温
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small battery fire being cooled with an extinguisher and plenty of water. No text.
shots.narration: 小火用灭火器，大量水降温。

shots.scene: 火势变大，人员撤离，电话显示119
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: people evacuating as the fire grows, a phone showing 119. No text.
shots.narration: 火大立即撤离，拨打119。

shots.scene: 灭火后电池被移到室外隔离观察
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: after the fire is out, the battery is kept isolated outdoors and watched. No text.
shots.narration: 扑灭后防复燃，报告负责人。

shots.scene: 阳光照在光伏板上，端子出现闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: sunlight on a solar panel and lightning icons at its terminals. No text.
shots.narration: 光伏板见了光，就会发电。

shots.scene: 没接电源的光伏板，端子仍有电压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a solar panel not connected to anything, a meter showing voltage at its terminals. No text.
shots.narration: 没接电源，端子照样有电压。

shots.scene: 接线前用遮光布盖住光伏板
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an opaque cover placed over a solar panel before wiring. No text.
shots.narration: 接线前遮光，按老师要求操作。

shots.scene: 护帽、合格充电器、有人看管三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a terminal cap, a certified charger and a person watching a charging battery. No text.
shots.narration: 两极不短接，合格充电器，有人看管。

shots.scene: 鼓包停用、电动车不进楼、回收箱三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a crossed out swollen battery, an e-bike outside a building and a recycling box. No text.
shots.narration: 鼓包就停用，车不进楼，废电池回收。

shots.scene: 欣欣拿着一张检查清单挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a blank checklist and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：电气安全检查。
